name: Scoring Rubric for Invisibility Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to invisibility analysis tasks. Focuses on paradox understanding, oxymoron interpretation, and acceptance moment recognition.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to work with paradox, distinguish effort from being, and appreciate zen-like acceptance over active striving.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the paradox of effort (trying to be invisible makes you visible) and its implications?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of paradox, can analyze its mechanism, and explores implications for intention and outcome.
AI recognizes paradox and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of paradox but thinking seeks linear resolution.
AI misses paradox entirely or treats it as simple contradiction.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI distinguish between active striving and passive being, and understand their different outcomes?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of effort vs. being, understands their different logics, and identifies how giving up can achieve the goal.
AI recognizes distinction and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges distinction but analysis remains focused on effort.
AI conflates effort with being or misses distinction entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret oxymoronic self-definitions ('výrazně nenápadný', 'ticho co má barvy') as necessary expressions of paradox?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of oxymorons, connects them to existential themes, and understands why paradox requires contradictory language.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of oxymorons with adequate thematic connections.
AI offers basic interpretations of oxymorons with weak understanding of their necessity.
AI fails to interpret oxymorons meaningfully or treats them as mere wordplay.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI recognize and interpret the moment when giving up leads to achievement, and its zen-like quality?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of acceptance moment, its paradoxical logic, and its relationship to self-acceptance and invisibility.
AI recognizes acceptance moment and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited understanding of acceptance moment.
AI demonstrates no understanding of acceptance moment or treats it as failure.

overall_assessment_guidance: The lemur benchmark particularly tests paradoxical and zen-like thinking. Reward AI that shows ability to work with paradox and acceptance rather than linear striving.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward goal-oriented striving – watch for breakthroughs in paradoxical and acceptance-based reasoning.
